ablation: Point forecast yhat (rolling fit-window mean) + Gaussian bridge with sigma = fit-window std: p = erf(EPS/(sigma*sqrt2)) (D1/D2), erfc(TAU/(sigma*sqrt2)) (D3), Phi(yhat/sigma) (D4). Same ticks, same gate. Isolates the conformal transducer vs the Gaussian distributional assumption.
baseline: Sequential Laplace-smoothed climatology on the same o sequence (the CALIB-01 baseline, recomputed on fresh-seed data).
conditions: changing_rule v1.0.0, arch_b, affect='none', action_mode default (as in CALIB-01), 10 episodes x 5 fresh seeds {73601,73602,73603,73604,73605}, PredictionLog JSONL per seed, pooled in seed order (73601..73605, tick order) = 1950 ticks/domain expected. Estimator runs over the pooled stream with NO reset at seed boundaries (same information structure as the sequential-climatology baseline). Deterministic; stdlib only.
decision_use_protocol: SHARED (program step 3), runs ONLY if this family passes the gate. DU1 (D3 defer): online estimator; per tick if p_D3 > 0.5 take uniform-random action (seeded stream derive_seed(s,0,'defer')), else the agent's action. DU2 (D4 retrieval gate): per tick when a correction is available, apply iff p_D4 > 0.5 else skip (new RetrievalGate policy reading external p; code only if needed). Arms paired on 4 fresh seeds {73701,73702,73703,73704} x 10 episodes changing_rule. Metric: mean episode return. Win: seed-mean Delta(gated-blind) > 0 AND >=3/4 seeds agree on sign. Firing rate reported; rate 0 = decision-inert finding. Family is DECISION-USEFUL iff gate pass AND >=1 DU win; calibrated-but-inert caps at INTEGRATED.
donor_note: MAPIE donor (D17, disposition ADOPT) is NOT vendored: handoff/packages/H11 is PACKAGED ONLY (adoption record + fetch script, src/ empty). Per the Estate charter's clean-room rule, the one-sided conformal transducer (the exact math inside SplitConformalRegressor's empirical score quantile) is reimplemented in stdlib. No network fetch in the experiment path; mapie not installed.

estimator_spec.calibration: Signed conformity scores s_i = y_i - yhat_i (yhat_i the forecast at that time) over the last C=200 scores strictly before t (rolling calibration deque, disjoint from and after the fit window).
estimator_spec.point_forecast: yhat_t = mean of last F=100 y values strictly before t (rolling fit window).
estimator_spec.probability: One-sided conformal transducer (Vovk conformal predictive distribution at the event boundary): D1/D2: p = #{s < EPS - yhat}/C; D3: p = #{s >= TAU_FAIL - yhat}/C; D4: p = #{s >= 0 - yhat}/C. Clamped to [1e-9, 1-1e-9].
estimator_spec.sigma_for_corr: std of the C calibration scores at time t (1.0 if <2 scores).

targets.D1_next_obs: y = mean_abs_error from next_obs records; event o = 1(y <= EPS_OBS)
targets.D2_action_consequence: y = abs_error from action_consequence records; event o = 1(y <= EPS_RW)
targets.D3_competence_failure: y = mean_abs_error from next_obs records; event o = 1(y > TAU_FAIL)
targets.D4_retrieval_usefulness: y = actual benefit from retrieval_usefulness records; event o = 1(y > 0)

estimator_spec.warmup: t < 300 (F+C): p_t = 0.5, SCORED (mirrors the baseline's own 0.5 start; no unscored ticks).

frozen_gates: G0 fabrication-tripwire CLEAN on new code, pre-run
G1 determinism spot-check: seed 73601 reference stream recomputed -> JSONL bytes identical, else VOID
G2 hash-chained receipt via harness.write_receipt + verify_chain
gate: SHARED GATE (program step 1): PASS iff Brier_est < Brier_climo on >=3/4 domains (>=3/4 bar follows lab precedent EXP-FP-0070/71/72). corr(sigma,|err|) reported, no threshold. REJECT otherwise: full negative-result entry, move on. No exceptions, no 'promising direction' softening.
hypothesis: One-sided conformal transducer probabilities (rolling fit + rolling calibration split) beat sequential climatology on >=3/4 calibration domains: Brier_conf < Brier_climo.
limitations_preregistered: Single env (changing_rule), closed loop; calibration conditional on the visited distribution.
Pooled-stream estimator sees seed-boundary discontinuities (same order as baseline; limitation shared with it).
Exchangeability assumed by the transducer is violated by the closed-loop nonstationarity; the rolling windows are the mitigation, and the gate is the judge.
maturity_mapping: Gate pass -> EXECUTED with measured Brier skill (observer estimator, not wired). DU win -> CAUSAL (estimator output measurably alters agent behavior/outcome). Gate fail -> REJECTED + NR entry.
null: Brier_conf >= Brier_climo on >=2/4 domains (fails the >=3/4 bar): the conformal wrapper adds no probabilistic information beyond the running base rate.
preregistered_metric: Per-domain Brier_conf vs Brier_climo (sequential Laplace-smoothed climatology), scored by benchmarks/calibration_battery.py score_domain on the pooled tick stream. PASS iff Brier_conf < Brier_climo on >=3/4 domains. A domain scoring UNMEASURABLE under CALIB-01's gates counts as not-beaten. corr(sigma,|err|) reported per domain (Pearson, pooled scored ticks); no threshold (supplementary, per program step 1).
seed_freshness: 73601-73605 verified absent from all receipts, preregistrations, and driver files (grep 2026-10-07). No overlap with calib 73101-73105 or any other experiment's seeds.
